label: conj:jet-tower-uniform-delta-max
title: Uniform per-level binding bound $|\Delta^{(n)}(\varrho)| \le \Delta_{\max}(\varrho)$ for the brane tower
html:
Conjecture (uniform per-level binding bound). For every confined vortex \varrho, there exists a finite real constant \Delta_{\max}(\varrho) < \infty bounding the per-level binding contribution:

  |\Delta^{(n)}(\varrho)| \;\le\; \Delta_{\max}(\varrho)
  \qquad\text{for all } n \ge 1.

The canonical formalism verifies this bound empirically at n = 1, 2, 3 for ^2\mathrm{H}, ^3\mathrm{H}, and ^3\mathrm{He}. The observed sequence decays geometrically by exactly \hbar_q^2, maintaining strict uniformity.

The geometric tail bound of the mass series relies conditionally on this conjecture. Future analytical proofs must either use the Gröbner-Shirshov spectral sequence E_2-collapse or apply a Yekutieli categorical rigidity bound to the descent involution.
heading: Conjecture
